description.text: The major is designed to train professionals to be good at communications technology, computer application technology, telecommunications systems and communication networks, who are capable of research, design, manufacturing, management in the communication field and the development of and the application of ICT equipment communications in various national economy departments and the national defense industry. After nearly 50 years development, it has formed a strong professional advantage with key disciplines, significant research results, high-qualified teachers, improved teaching and learning conditions, communications-oriented industries, and good employment of the graduates. It is featured with communications-oriented operating and maintenance, with emphasis on students' telecommunication concept in communication system, transmission, and network so that students are capable of communication system management and telecommunications network maintenance.

duration.text: The Science of Animation at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
